prompt:

Preserve all extra small guard projections visible underneath the main wings. Ring pommel holes must stay fully open and transparent with exact guide diameter. Do not shrink the holes or fill them. Both painted and red-mask copies must have the exact smooth original silhouettes, without red/yellow fringe, speckles or stray pixels. Use flat diffuse colors on upper half, avoiding reflective highlights. Exact guide geometry is mandatory.
validation_notes: Layout retained; visible edge artifacts and silhouette deviations remain after the one permitted correction.
